institutionName: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Career opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Social and academical aspects

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was quite challenging to navigate between the mobility portal and the host universitys course website

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I did not really receive any assistance

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was quite hard since i never got a message saying that i was not taken into consideration when it came to student housing by the university. This made me travel there without a place to live. However the 'Tak over hodet' plan was very helpful.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It can be better than living on campus, since it is posible to find housing more city centred.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It does not make any sense that scandinavian students were not taken into consideration when it came to housing on campus. since it does not give any advantage to find housing being from Denmark.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Was very hard to find out if courses lectures clashed.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Over months i was sent multiple links for registration not seeming to easy and simple to find deadlines.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: An e-mail adress.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I would tell them what studentweb is used for and blackboard.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I was taking MA courses there to meet the language barrier, and the level of the courses seem equal or maybe a little lower than what im used to at UCPH.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Way less group work or hours that i should be at the institution to receive education. Way less active education.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
- MOL3005 
- MOL3000 
- TMMT - Sustainable Food Production
- KLH - Obesity

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
MOL3005 - Very learning and enriching course with a nice course coordinator and a nice assignment. 
KLH Obesity - Very exciting small course with a nice course coordinator. Very good lectures and expert lecturers.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Try to find a place to live before arriving
2. Bring warm clothes 
3. Try to start with the websites as quickly as possible (Studentweb, Blackboard)

questions.answer: Dont think so

questions.answer: The new friendships that i got through the exchange and some of the knowledge that i gathered.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The lack of sun
